en: The front of the postcard features a black and white photograph of a woman dressed in an elaborate costume, likely for a stage performance. The woman is posing barefoot, with her arms crossed over her chest. On her head is an ornate headdress with flowers and jewelry. The text at the bottom left reads 'Tilla Durieux a Salome' and at the bottom right is 'Otto Becker, Hans, phot.' The reverse of the postcard displays multiple languages for the word 'Postcard', following the 'Union postale universelle' format, with no handwritten message or address.
